description: The issues of the shown space from Jira Cloud or GitHub, with a page for each issue, a Move menu for its Jira status and a button that starts an agent on it. Based on Herdr Ranch.

settings.label: Order
settings.hint: By priority: the issues in groups by priority. Backlog order: the order of the Jira backlog.

settings.label: Page
settings.hint: Where an issue opens. Overlay: in a dialog over the window. Split: under the list. Full: in the place of the list.

settings.label: Extra Jira fields
settings.hint: Jira fields for the Start agent prompts, by name or id, split by commas. Each one is a placeholder ({refinement}) and {fields} holds all of them. The issue page shows them under the description.

settings.label: Shortcut
settings.hint: Opens the Issues window. Saved in keys.json.
